text:
sam-docs: Quick sync: found two issues across model-catalog PRs: bench page states "per-variant seq_len=2048" while model-card for v2 lists max_context=4096; and the compatibility matrix links to an old runtime flags doc (404).

lee-ml: For the bench mismatch, benchmarks were collected with rolling-window=2048 to compare older models fairly. We should call that out instead of changing model-card limits.

jamie-eng: For the broken link, runtime flags moved last month. Public docs should link to /docs/runtime-flags#compatibility. I can update the matrix link and add an anchor.

sam-docs: Proposed actions:
1) Add a bench column "truncation / measurement" that says "benchmarks use rolling-window=2048 unless noted".
2) Leave model-card max_context=4096 but add a note: "benchmarks use 2048 rolling window for apples-to-apples comparison".
3) Fix compatibility matrix link to /docs/runtime-flags#compatibility and add a tooltip noting Private deployments may have different defaults.
4) Add a public-docs-only CI test that verifies external links return 200 (whitelist internal hosts).

jamie-eng: I'll do 3 and 4. Make the link-check CI fail only on public docs to avoid internal host flakiness.

sdk-bot: Also flag: embeddings page example uses alias `nova-lite`. With the bench note we should add a one-line compatibility callout about aliases vs explicit variants for Private.

lee-ml: Agreed. Add: "Aliases map to variants in Hosted; Private may require explicit variant names." in the model-catalog compatibility section.

sam-docs: I'll open a docs PR for the bench column and model-card note. Jamie, please keep the link-fix PR separate. I'll include a minimal smoke test for the example snippets that runs with a mocked client:

```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(base_url="https://mock.redwood")
c.resolve_variant("nova-lite")
```

qa-bot: Reminder: add the example smoke tests to the examples suite; they should run in CI with mocking enabled.

sam-docs: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5502 — "model-catalog: clarify benchmark measurement, fix compatibility links, add snippet smoke test"

jamie-eng: LGTM pending CI; left a nit on tooltip wording.

lee-ml: Approved.

qa-bot: Public link checks passed :white_check_mark:. Example smoke tests with mocked resolve_variant passed :white_check_mark:.

sam-docs: Merged and added changelog entry. Will draft KB note summarizing alias/variant differences for Private customers.

lee-ml: Great, should cut down alias-related support tickets.

sam-docs: Closing thread after KB is posted.
